name: taskmaster-pei
description: TaskMaster PEI - Multi-Platform Task Management System

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "GW,AUTH,USER,TASK,RPT,NOTIF,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta,red,white" "npm run gw" "npm run auth" "npm run user" "npm run task" "npm run report" "npm run notif" "npm run electron"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n "GW,AUTH,USER,TASK,RPT,NOTIF" -c "cyan,green,yellow,blue,magenta,red" "npm run gw" "npm run auth" "npm run user" "npm run task" "npm run report" "npm run notif"
scripts.db:migrate: cd packages/database && npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:push: cd packages/database && npx prisma db push
